name: ReadInvoiceLinesLive
description: Reads the lines of ONE invoice live from Priority (CINVOICES or AINVOICES /CINVOICEITEMS_SUBFORM via the Priority integration, read-only) and upserts them into InvoiceLines (priorityKey = <form>:<IVNUM>:<KLINE>, source priority-direct). Called when someone opens an invoice or a price dispute. No bulk load.

error.description: Set when Priority could not be read; lines then holds the mirror's last copy

usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Anyone opening an invoice**: Opening the invoice pop-up from any invoice number
  Reads the invoice's current lines straight from Priority so the lines shown are up to date; if Priority can't be reached, the last saved copy is shown.
- **Collections team, price dispute case page**: Opening a price dispute
  Reads the disputed invoice's lines live from Priority and shows them on the case.
